scenario: Pure technical troubleshooting call with no personal data at all.
notes: Negative control for false positives. Any detection here is over-redaction on a transcript that should pass through untouched, and would push a speculative-parallel pipeline into an unnecessary re-summarization.

conversation.text: Thanks for holding. What seems to be happening with the connection?
The modem drops out every evening around eight and comes back a few minutes later.
I'm seeing repeated upstream errors on the line. That usually points to a signal issue outside the home.
Is that something you can fix remotely or does someone need to come out?
I've rebooted the equipment from here and scheduled a line check. If it drops again tomorrow, a technician visit is the next step.
That works. I'll keep an eye on it tonight and call back if nothing changes.
